title: 维克兹·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 单颗巨大眼睛嵌于紫色分节甲壳，三条弯曲触须围绕悬浮身形。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Vel’Koz is a floating nonhuman observer with one enormous central eye, purple segmented armor, and three clearly separated curling tentacles. Preserve the single-eye structure, layered shell plates, and suspended body without human legs, extra eyes, teeth, lasers, exposed tissue, or unrelated mechanical additions.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: violet, indigo, pale cyan, plum, stone gray; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
